title: Print Farm Utilization Dashboard
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=octoprint:job
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(print_time_s) as busy_s by printer _time
| eval utilization_pct=round(100*busy_s/86400,1)
| stats avg(utilization_pct) as avg_util by printer
| sort - avg_util
description: Measures how much of each day your printers are actually printing so you can balance load or justify another machine.
value: Utilization reveals whether a printer is a bottleneck or idle capacity, guiding both scheduling and buying decisions.
implementation: Ingest print durations; schedule daily and compute per-printer utilization over time.
visualization: Bar chart of average daily utilization by printer.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how busy each of your 3D printers is, so you can share the work or decide if you need another.
